name: parcel-concierge
description: Parcel Concierge: a parcel delivery and customs MCP server for Alexa+, with a simulated Alexa+ web app.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/domain && concurrently -k -n domain,mcp,agent,web -c gray,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w packages/domain" "npm run dev -w apps/mcp-server" "npm run dev -w apps/agent-api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w apps/mcp-server && npm run build -w apps/agent-api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n mcp,agent -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w apps/mcp-server" "npm run start -w apps/agent-api"
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/domain && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/domain && tsc -p apps/mcp-server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/agent-api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
